subject: *: disable insert null to not-null column for single-row insertion in non-strict mode (#55477)
summary: Implements MySQL-compatible NULL-to-NOT-NULL handling by treating bad-NULL as an error for single-row INSERT (VALUES/SETlist) even when sql_mode is non-strict, while keeping multi-row INSERT and INSERT ... SELECT as warning+implicit-default. Adds a dedicated errctx group for “no default value” errors (ErrGroupNoDefault) so missing-default behavior isn’t accidentally tightened by the single-row bad-NULL rule, and updates table default-check logic accordingly.
